name: Mime_1
short_caption: The robot mimes holding or patting an invisible wall in front of its chest.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture and raises both hands up in front of its chest, palms facing forward with slightly curled fingers as if touching a vertical flat surface. It holds this position briefly, making subtle micro-movements with its fingers and wrists to simulate feeling a barrier, and then drops both arms back down to its sides to return to the neutral posture.
